author: benaye
body:
I hopped onto Avicus this morning (forums) to find out I was banned for "Excessive Disrespect and Toxicity to others". I agree with this completely.

I was just wondering, how long will I have to wait until I appeal? I haven't seen perms for this type of infraction in quite some while.

title: How long do I have to wait?

replies.author: joelous
replies.body: Depending on how your behaviour is, and how much you have contributed to Avicus in any way possible. If we feel like you have shown that you have improved, you may only have to wait a couple of weeks to a month or two. Otherwise you'll be on the sidelines for 3-4 months, usually.
